 Follow One Piece Chapter 1199 Spoilers & Manga Plot Leaks
 Ishita Verma Wed, November 18, 2026 at 8:58 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Toei Animation | Crunchyroll Pew Piece posted One Piece Chapter 1199 spoilers on Instagram after a long break. In the previous chapter, Luffy reportedly unleashed a new form after stepping away from the battle against Imu for a while. Here are all the details fans need to know regarding the plot leaks for Chapter 1199 of the One Piece manga.
 List of One Piece Chapter 1199 spoilers
 The One Piece Chapter 1199 spoilers are listed below.
 Luffy starts beating his chest in his new form
 According to plot leaks posted on Instagram, Chapter 1199 focuses on Luffy's mysterious form, which was unveiled at the end of the previous chapter. In addition, Scopper Gaban revealed that Luffy is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit user. Luffy is said to have an ape-like form with a tail and fangs. The chapter reveals that Luffy mysteriously starts beating his chest. The sound from the beating seemed like the Drums of Liberation to the Giants. However, one of the giants suggested that the rhythm was different from that of the drums.
 Luffy gets ready to attack Dorry and Brogy
 The scene then shifts to the battle between Sanji and Saint Killingham, where the latter tries to run from the Straw Hat Pirates after his armor shatters. Sanji aims his attack at Killingham's heart, but misses. Meanwhile, after Luffy bites the rain god Zaza and she explodes, he looks for the ship where Dorry and Brogy are. He attacks the giants by throwing a house at them, which they stop easily. Readers then see Luffy holding lightning in his right hand and a shield made of clouds in his other hand, ready to attack Dorry and Brogy.
 Robin gets Lili's letter
 The chapter then shifts its focus to the World Government leader, Imu, who proceeds toward the village. On the other hand, his mysterious shadow creatures march toward the ship carrying the giant children. At the end of the chapter, Robin appears with a letter from Lili. In the letter, she notices the name Nefertari from Alabasta and decides to read it.
